package audit

import (
	"context"

	models "example.test/auditapp/internal/models/audit"
	rules "example.test/auditapp/internal/rules/audit"
	"example.test/auditapp/internal/scope"
)

const verifyBatch = 100

// Verify recomputes every stored event hash of the verified tenant.
func Verify(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	p VerifyPorts,
	_ models.VerifyRequest,
) (models.Verification, error) {
	result := models.Verification{Valid: true}

	var after int64

	for {
		batch, err := p.Events.Scan(ctx, e, after, verifyBatch)
		if err != nil {
			return models.Verification{}, err
		}

		for _, entry := range batch {
			result.Checked++

			if entry.Hash != rules.EventHash(entry.Type, entry.Payload) {
				result.Valid = false
			}

			after = entry.Seq
		}

		if len(batch) < verifyBatch {
			return result, nil
		}
	}
}
